title: Quiznos Files For Prepackaged Chapter 11 To Execute Financial Restructuring And Implement Operational Enhancements; Restaurants Open And Operating As Usual
主要内容: Quiznos, a leading quick-service restaurant chain, has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy to execute a pre-packaged financial restructuring plan. The plan aims to reduce the company's debt by over $400 million, enhancing operational flexibility and strengthening the brand. The restructuring includes reducing food costs, implementing a franchise owner rebate program, and investing in advertising. Quiznos has secured $15 million in debtor-in-possession financing to support ongoing operations. All but seven of its nearly 2,100 restaurants are independently owned and continue to operate normally. The company expects to emerge from the restructuring process quickly, with a focus on improving growth and profitability for franchisees. The restructuring plan includes new technology and operational improvements to support franchisees effectively. Quiznos has established a restructuring hotline for inquiries and additional information is available on its website.
